Chapter 555: Chapter 9: Another Tremor of the Door to the Myriad Realms (Subscription Requested)

“Where is the enemy?”

Xilan was somewhat stunned, the enormous figure behind him stirring the heavy spatial layers with such a large body, and still it remained unseen?

The chase between Xilan and the enormous figure had not concealed their presences. Even though they were very distant, and in different spatial layers, they could still feel each other.

This was also the reason why Xilan was worried about the occurrence of variables.

“Galaxy Master, the ‘Maduo Traveler’ who is chasing me has great strength, nearing the Ninth Rank Millionfold Realm. Even if we join forces, we cannot resist him,”

Xilan said quickly.

...

He had only been able to escape from the ‘Maduo Traveler’ so far because of his unique evolutionary path and mastering a secret technique for escaping.

But Lin Yuan did not.

Once targeted by the ‘Maduo Traveler,’ the consequences were unimaginable.

“Galaxy Master, please do not come near us.”

Xilan once again reminded.

Even though the news of Lin Yuan killing the Three-Headed Alien Race ‘Oliven’ had come out five years ago,

‘Oliven’ was merely a Ninth Rank Myriad Layer Realm powerhouse, having initiated only more than twenty thousand spatial layers, whereas the ‘Maduo Traveler,’ who had initiated more than nine hundred thousand spatial layers, was not on the same level.

“No harm, come toward me,”

Lin Yuan transmitted through the black disc.

“You still want me to come over?”

Xilan immediately reacted.

Lin Yuan had not failed to see the fierce and formidable ‘Maduo Traveler.’ Instead, he had his own confidence.

Although Xilan did not know with what Lin Yuan was planning to counter the nearly Millionfold Realm ‘Maduo Traveler,’ judging from the time spent with the Galaxy Master,

Xilan knew well that the Galaxy Master’s character was not that of an arrogantly overconfident evolver.

If the Galaxy Master asked him to come over, he must have had a way to deal with the ‘Maduo Traveler.’

“Okay.”

Xilan did not hesitate and began to move in Lin Yuan’s direction.

“Galaxy Master, while the ‘Maduo Traveler’ was not paying attention, I took a treasure he had been guarding for a long time…”

While getting closer to Lin Yuan, Xilan explained the causes and consequences.

The ‘Maduo Traveler’ is the descendant of a powerful ‘Ancient God’ deep within the Cosmic Starry Skies.

That ‘Ancient God’ had not taken part in the wars for domination among the universe’s races, and the ‘Maduo Traveler’ had no significant hatred for human civilization.

The ‘Maduo Traveler’ had been chasing Xilan this long purely because he was annoyed by Xilan,

and the treasure was indeed not simple, nearly as potent as a ten-star rare treasure.

Swoosh.

Lin Yuan and Xilan successfully converged.

Immediately after, the towering Maduo Traveler also arrived in pursuit.

“Galaxy Master!” the Maduo Traveler quickly recognized Lin Yuan, unable to help it as the Galaxy Master was too renowned and even a Supreme Being had heard of him.

“Maduo Traveler,” Lin Yuan said in a calm tone, “Xuanhuang Secret Realm offers countless opportunities. With the time you’ve spent chasing, you probably could have found the next location by now.”

“So protective of your race, Galaxy Master?” the Maduo Traveler fumed internally, “But today, if you do not hand over that treasure, I won’t even consider the face of the Galaxy Master.”

Under normal circumstances, the Maduo Traveler would have been quite willing to give face to the Galaxy Master.

With the potential of the Galaxy Master, reaching the Ninth Rank Million Heavy Realm was almost inevitable in the future; offending such a formidable future powerhouse was not wise for the Maduo Traveler.

There was no reconciliation between the Insect Race, Tianyu Clan, and human civilization. However, there was not much direct hatred between him, the Maduo Traveler, and humans or the Galaxy Master.

In the cosmic starry skies, having more friends meant having more paths.

But now, the Maduo Traveler really couldn’t swallow his pride.

“If that’s the case, make your move,” Lin Yuan said bluntly.

Rumble.

The two instantly entered a deeper layer of spatial layers to begin their battle.

…..

Not far away.

Xilan was carefully sensing the dreadful fluctuations coming from the deeper spatial layers.

“Has the Galaxy Master engaged with the Maduo Traveler?” Xilan murmured, “And this battle fluctuation, it hasn’t immediately collapsed?”

Xilan dared not get near the spatial layer where Lin Yuan and the Maduo Traveler were fighting, but judging by the fluctuations caused by their battle, he could deduce the rough situation.

Xilan’s eyes were somewhat vacant, the growth rate of the Galaxy Master was too rapid; he still remembered that not long ago, he had been escorting the Galaxy Master to his homeworld?

At that time, the Galaxy Master had just entered the Ninth Rank, appearing as if he knew nothing?

And now, in a blink of an eye, he had reached a level to contend with the Maduo Traveler?

“Too terrifying,”

“Truly worthy of being the most dazzling unrivaled genius in the history of our human civilization.”

Xilan swallowed, back on the Battlefields of Different Races, he had been thinking about how to protect Lin Yuan from being assassinated by that Ninth Rank powerhouse from the Tianyu Clan.

Now, however, it was Lin Yuan’s turn to protect him?

The roles had switched, yet the time between them was exceedingly short.

…

Deep within the heavy spatial layers.

Lin Yuan and the Maduo Traveler confronted each other, separated by dozens of spatial layers.

“Galaxy Master, I never expected you to be this strong. You almost inflicted severe damage on me,” the Maduo Traveler stared intently at Lin Yuan, his heart trembling slightly.

Just now, as he and the Galaxy Master had delved into the heavy spatial layers, the instant they collided, the Maduo Traveler had felt an unimaginable force penetrating him.

If it weren’t for his awakening ‘Ancient God’ talent and timely withdrawal, he might have been severely wounded by now.

Talent?

Secret technique?

Treasure?

Or something else?

The Maduo Traveler’s mind was filled with doubts.

He had initially thought he could suppress the Galaxy Master. Even if the latter could surpass him in the future, at least for now the Maduo Traveler thought he was stronger than the Galaxy Master.

But after their recent clash, the Maduo Traveler instantly concluded that he could not overcome the Galaxy Master.
